findings.title: No security-blocking findings
findings.detail: Managed BOS execution validates canonical repositoryId and issueNumber, re-fetches the confirmed Goal projection for every logical turn or repair cycle, and fails closed on missing approval/proposal identity, malformed execution windows or budgets, provider failures, invalid inheritance responses, and ambiguous gateway decisions.

findings.title: Authorization and aggregate budget enforcement are gateway-bound
findings.detail: Included work and strictly-derived repairs inherit the exact approval/proposal identity and must receive an affirmative authoritative gateway check before execution; pending scope changes, out-of-scope issues, closed windows, and exhausted ceilings pause execution.

findings.title: Exact candidate and validation evidence confirmed
findings.detail: Local HEAD and remote bos/issue-53 both equal aed939a508bf0ae1aca96532bf35a39dc3254b19. Exact-commit evidence confirms mix format --check-formatted, mix test (385 tests, 0 failures, 2 skipped), git diff --check, and the focused goal_execution_test.exs suite (11 tests, 0 failures).

summary: Passed security review: exact local/remote candidate identity and exact-commit tests are confirmed; targeted inspection found fail-closed managed identity, approval/scope/window/budget checks and authoritative per-turn/per-repair gateway authorization with no security-blocking findings.
